_doc: Machine-readable SSOT for PROJECT.md §변경 유형 → 갱신 위치 매핑. Consumed by user-guide-sync-reviewer (stable change_type enumeration) and validated by .claude/tests/test_doc_sync_matrix.py. The PROJECT.md prose table is the human-readable companion; the test binds the two (same row count) and checks that every guard_test / convention_ref / concrete path resolves. Edit BOTH together — the test fails on divergence.

_schema.change_type: human label; its core phrase must also appear in the PROJECT.md table
_schema.trigger: { globs: [...], match: 'glob' | 'semantic' } — semantic rows have no clean glob and need reviewer judgment
_schema.targets: human-readable required co-update locations (may contain <placeholders>/{ko,en} braces). A spec/<area key>/<KEY>.md target is the read-only NERV mirror: update the spec through a NERV draft (/nerv:spec edit <KEY>); implementation PRs commit the mirror pulled with pull.py --task. Spec paths here must be existing mirror files (test_doc_sync_matrix.py).
_schema.verify: verification command string (literal), or null if manual/none
_schema.guard_tests: specific *.test.ts files this row's guard relies on (subset, existence-checked)
_schema.convention_ref: NERV mirror path spec/<area key>/<KEY>.md of the SoT spec, or null
